description: Department of Fiscal Policy - The Finance Act, No. 11 of 2006 - Regulations as the Finance (Teledrama, Film and Commercials Levy) No. 1 of 2017
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the declaration of new regulations under the Finance Act, specifically the Finance (Teledrama, Film and Commercials Levy) Regulations. It establishes legal frameworks for levies, exemptions, certification requirements, and appeal processes for media content. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the main purpose of publishing regulatory changes, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette rather than a government personnel or hybrid type.
